name: Paper Dress Vintage
summary: A vintage shop on Mare Street that becomes a bar, gig venue and club after dark. By day it sells hand-picked pieces dating from Victorian times to the 1990s.

music.notes: Live music on five evenings each week, with club nights at the weekend. Outside promoters book most shows; the venue programmes a few itself each month.

crowd: The venue says it wants its music nights to feel accessible and welcoming to everyone.

accessibility.notes: Gigs and club nights are upstairs, 20 steps up, and are standing only, though a seat can be arranged if you contact the venue beforehand. The ground-floor bar has no steps. Gender-neutral toilets are on the first floor.

evidence.quote: Join us in the evening for a transformed atmosphere, where our vintage shop becomes a vibrant live music venue and nightclub.
Indulge in our fully stocked bar offering craft beer and cocktails, while enjoying live music events five nights a week and club nights on weekends.
we pride ourselves on hand-sourcing exquisite pieces from across the UK, spanning the Victorian era to the 1990s.
The majority of our events are booked by external promoters and we only program a small number of events in-house per month.
The venue is strictly 18+ after 8pm in accordance with our licensing conditions set out by Hackney Council.
There is no step-free access to the performance space where we host gigs and club nights. To access the performance space at Paper Dress, there are 20 steps up.
The performance space is a standing-only venue. However, for those who are unable to stand for long periods of time it is possible to arrange a seat. Please contact us in advance to make arrangements
Our ground floor bar has step-free access.
We have gender-neutral toilets with 2 cubicles and a urinal, located on our first floor.
Unfortunately we do not have a wheelchair accessible toilet on the premises.
Our mission is to present high quality music experiences which are accessible & welcoming for all.
